==Esperanto==

===Etymology===
{{ety|eo|:bor|de:ja|text=+|tree=1}} Compare {{cog|pl|jo}}, {{cog|yi|יאָ}}, {{cog|en|yea}}. Related to {{m|eo|jes}}.

===Pronunciation===
{{eo-pr|a=LL-Q143 (epo)-Lepticed7-ja.wav;LL-Q143 (epo)-Robin van der Vliet-ja.wav}}

===Adverb===
{{head|eo|adverb}}

# {{non-gloss|emphatic particle}}; [[indeed]], [[certainly]], [[surely]], [[after all]]
#* {{RQ:Plato Broadribb Respubliko|page=18|passage="Nu, Kefalo," mi diris, "mi '''ja''' ĝuas konversacii kun maljunuloj. Mi opinias ke ni devus lerni de personoj kiuj jam laŭiris la vojon laŭ kiu ankaŭ ni mem devos iri."|t="Well, Cephalus," I said, "I '''certainly''' enjoy conversing with old people. I have the opinion that we should learn from people who already went along the path along which we ourselves will also have to go."}}
#* {{quote-book|eo|title=Krimeo estas nia|author=Kalle Kniivilä|year=2015|chapter=Sopiro al Sovetio|passage=Sed la bona soveta tempo neniam revenos. Ĝi '''ja''' neniam ekzistis.|translation=But the good Soviet times will never return. '''After all''', they never existed.|lit=But the good Soviet time will never come again. It '''indeed''' never existed.|trans-title=Crimea is ours|trans-chapter=Yearning for the Soviet Union}}

====Usage notes====
The word {{m|eo|ja}} emphasizes the entire sentence or a specific word or phrase, stressing the reality of it. It is most often placed before or after the sentence's main verb, or before an adverb modifying the main verb. Otherwise, it is usually placed in front of a word or phrase that it emphasizes.

It is also commonly used for emphatic negation, combined with {{m|eo|ne}} or a correlative starting in {{m|eo|neni-}}, usually with {{m|eo|ja}} placed in front of it.

====Derived terms====
* {{l|eo|jes ja||yes indeed}}

====Related terms====

|ekzakte<t:exactly>
|fakte<t:in fact>
|ĝuste<t:just, right, exactly>
|reale<t:really, actually>
|vere<t:truly>
}}

==Finnish==

===Etymology===
From {{inh|fi|urj-fin-pro|*ja}} (compare {{cog|et|ja}}, {{cog|izh|ja}}, {{cog|liv|ja}}, {{cog|vot|ja}}), borrowed from {{der|fi|gem-pro|*jahw|t=and}} (compare {{cog|got|𐌾𐌰𐌷}}, {{cog|goh|ja}}, {{m|goh|joh}}). Attested {{fi-attest|agricola}}.<ref>{{R:Hakkinen 2005}}</ref>

===Pronunciation===
{{fi-pronunciation|a=Fi-ja.ogg}}

===Conjunction===
{{head-lite|fi|conjunctions}}

# {{lb|fi|coordinating}} [[and]]
#: {{syn|fi|sekä|qq1=see note|ynnä|qq2=dated|plus|qq3=informal}}
#: {{uxi|fi|Siellä oli poikia '''ja''' tyttöjä.|There were boys '''and''' girls there.}}
#: {{uxi|fi|Menin kotiin '''ja''' aloin soittaa pianoa.|I went home '''and''' started playing the piano.}}
#: {{uxi|fi|Iltapalaksi on leipää, juustoa, kinkkua, tomaattia '''ja''' maitoa.|For supper we have bread, cheese, ham, tomato '''and''' milk.}}
#: {{uxi|fi|Mies juoksee '''ja''' juoksee.|The man runs '''and''' runs.}}
#: {{uxi|fi|'''Ja''' sitten alkoi sataa.|'''And''' then it started raining.}}
#: {{uxi|fi|Mene '''ja''' tiedä.|Go figure.|lit=Go '''and''' know.}}
#: {{uxi|fi|viisi '''ja''' puoli|five '''and''' a half}}
#: {{uxi|fi|ensimmäisen '''ja''' viimeisen kerran|for the first '''and''' the last time}}

====Usage notes====
* On the differences between {{m-lite|fi||ja}} and {{m-lite|fi|sekä}}:
** {{m-lite|fi||ja}} can be used more widely than {{m-lite|fi|sekä}}. As an example, {{m-lite|fi||sekä}} may not be used to join two independent clauses.
**: {{uxi|fi|Vaahdota voi '''sekä''' sokeri <u>'''ja'''</u> sekoita joukkoon kuivat aineet.|Cream the butter '''and''' sugar, '''and''' mix in the dry ingredients.}}
** {{m-lite|fi||sekä}} has a nuance of the things being more separate than with {{m-lite|fi||ja}}. If both words are used, {{m-lite|fi||ja}} ties things closer together than {{m-lite|fi||sekä}}.
**: {{uxi|fi|mansikka- <u>'''ja'''</u> vadelmahillo '''sekä''' muut hedelmäsäilykkeet|strawberry <u>'''and'''</u> raspberry jam '''as well as''' other fruit preserves}}
** In legal language, {{m-lite|fi||ja}} and {{m-lite|fi|sekä}} are distinguished more clearly. {{m-lite|fi||sekä}} is considered "stronger" than {{m-lite|fi||ja}}. For example, an attribute specified before a list will apply to every item with {{m-lite|fi||ja}}, but not with {{m-lite|fi||sekä}}.
**: {{uxi|fi|paineella tyhjennettävät <u>'''ja'''</u> täytettävät säiliöt|containers that can be filled '''and''' emptied under pressure|footer== containers that are both filled and emptied under pressure}}
**: {{uxi|fi|paineella tyhjennettävät <u>'''sekä'''</u> täytettävät säiliöt|containers that can be filled '''and''' emptied under pressure|footer== containers that are emptied under pressure, and which can be filled either under pressure or not}}

===Adverb===
{{head-lite|fi|adverbs}}

# {{lb|fi|dialectal}} [[also]], [[as well]] {{lb|fi|!primarily|Southwest|Satakunta|Tavastia|Uusimaa|Kymenlaakso|South Karelia}}
#: {{syn|fi|-kin|myös}}

===Noun===
{{head-lite|fi|nouns}}

# [[AND]] {{gloss|logic gate or connector}}

====Usage notes====
Often spelled in capital letters ({{m-lite|fi||JA}}).

====Declension====
Not inflected. If inflection is necessary, it is used as the first component in a compound, such as {{m-lite|fi|JA-portti||AND gate}}, and {{m-lite|fi|portti}} is then inflected.

==German==

===Etymology===
{{etymon|de|id=yes|:inh|gmh:ja<id:yes><ety:inh<goh:ja<id:yes><ety:inh<gem-pro:*ja<id:yes>>>>>}}
From {{inh|de|gmh|ja}}, from {{inh|de|goh|ja|ja, jā|yes}}, from {{inh|de|gem-pro|*ja|t=yes}}. Cognate with {{cog|yi|יאָ}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|de|[jäː]|aa=Standard, overall more common}}
* {{IPA|de|[ʝäː]|aa=standard, overall less common}}
* {{audio|de|De-ja.ogg}}
* {{audio|de|CPIDL German - Ja.ogg}}
* {{IPA|de|[jɑː]|aa=Austrian German}}
* {{IPA|de|[jɒ~jɔ]|aa=Austrian German, common in casual speech as an influence of the Austro-Bavarian language}}
* {{rhymes|de|aː|s=1}}
* {{homophone|de|Jahr}} {{a|de|according to a widespread pronunciation of this word}}

===Adverb===
{{de-adv}} {{tlb|de|modal particle}}

# [[obviously]]; [[certainly]]; [[of course]]; as you know; as is generally known {{n-g|(indicates and emphasises that one is expressing an established fact)}}
#: {{syn|de|doch|bekanntlich|bekanntermaßen}}
#: {{uxi|de|Es kann '''ja''' nicht immer so bleiben.|It '''obviously''' cannot always remain so.}}
#: {{uxi|de|Der Peter war '''ja''' gestern krank.|Peter was sick yesterday, '''as you know'''.}}
# {{lb|de|informal}} under any [[circumstances]], [[for certain|for (absolute) certain]] {{q|often with the implication of pettiness, insecurity or overblown fear regarding the issue one wants certainty on}}
#: {{ux|de|Er fragt jedes Mal mindestens fünf Mal nach, um auch '''ja''' alles richtig zu machen.|Eery time, he asks to make sure at least five times to '''be absolutely positively sure''' that he does it all correctly.}}
#: {{ux|de|Wenn der Lehrer eine Frage stellt, schauen alle auf den Boden und hoffen, '''ja''' nicht aufgerufen zu werden.|When the teacher asks a question, everybody's staring at the ground, hoping to not get called on '''under any circumstances'''.}}
#* {{quote-newsgroup|de|date=1999-08-08|author=Hosse & Schwarzkopf|title=Gestose|newsgroup=de.sci.medizin.misc|url=https://groups.google.com/g/de.sci.medizin.misc/c/iOWz0DcZt4c/m/ewZR1kMKf30J|text=Ihrer Meinung nach darf ich jetzt nicht mehr soviel Flüssigkeit (höchstens 2 Liter) und Salz zu mir nehmen, damit ich '''ja''' keine Gestose entwickele.|t=In her opinion I shouldn't be consuming as much fluid (2 liters max) and salt now anymore, so that I won't develop gestosis '''under any circumstances'''.}}
## [[had better]]; {{n-g|used to reinforce an imperative or other order with an implied threat, especially by an authority figure}}.
##: {{ux|de|Komm '''ja''' nicht zu spät nach Hause!|You''''d better''' not be late in coming back home!}}

====Usage notes====
* In the sense of "obviously", it is always unstressed; while in the sense of "under any circumstances" it is always stressed.
* {{sense|obviously}} {{m|de||Ja}} means roughly the same as English ''obviously'' or ''as you know'', but given its shortness it is used much more frequently. In colloquial German, {{m|de||ja}} is used in most statements of facts already known to the one addressed.

===Interjection===
{{head|de|interjection}}

# [[yes]]; [[yea]]; [[yeah]]; [[aye]]
#: {{syn|de|jawohl}}
#: {{ant|de|nein}}
#: {{ux|de|Willst du das? '''Ja'''.|Do you want that? '''Yes'''.|inline=y}}
#: {{ux|de|Aber '''ja'''!|'''Yes''', of course!|inline=y}}

====Usage notes====
* {{m|de||Ja}} is used to indicate agreement with a positive statement. To contradict a negative statement (where English would use “yes”), {{m|de|doch}} is used instead.

* {{l|de|jap}}
* {{l|de|jein}}

{{inh+|vls|dum|ja}}, from {{inh|vls|odt|*jā}}, from {{inh|vls|gem-pro|*ja}}.

===Pronunciation===
{{rfp|vls}}

===Adverb===
{{head|vls|adverb}}

# [[yes]]

====Inflection====
Contracted forms of ''ja'' with a following personal pronoun are common in West Flemish; thus ''ja ik'' contracts to {{m|vls|joak}}. See {{w|West_Flemish#Conjugation_of_yes_and_no|English Wikipedia}} and {{w|lang=vls|Wikipedia:Vervoegienge van ja, nêe en ols|West Flemish Wikipedia}} for more information. {{attention|vls|table requires cleanup to match rest of Wiktionary}}

==Yoruba==

===Etymology 1===
{{etymid|yo|fight}}
Cognate with {{cog|igl|jà|t=to fight}}

====Pronunciation====
* {{yo-IPA|jà}}

====Verb====
{{yo-verb|jà}}

# {{lb|yo|intransitive|reciprocal}} to [[fight]], to [[wrestle]], to [[struggle]]
# {{lb|yo|intransitive}} to [[occur]], to [[take place]], to [[break out]] (as in a war or disease)
#: {{syn|yo|já}}
#: {{uxi|yo|ogún '''jà'''|War '''broke out'''}}

=====Usage notes=====
* '''ja''' before a direct object
